meta.title: Brand
meta.description: The zerosoft brand guide: the name, the logo, the stations, the eleven lines, type, voice and the suite map. With the kit to download.

hero.sub: Each app is a line with its own color. Change at any station: a booking in Cal creates the contact in CRM.
hero.kit: The kit has the logo and symbols as SVG and PNG (512 and 1024 px), plus both typefaces with their OFL license.

map.title: zerosoft network map: eleven lines and their interchange stations
map.hint: Hover a line or a station to see what it connects to.
map.hintTouch: Tap a station to see what it connects to.

lines.link: Link: every link created or clicked can trigger a flow, and a flow creates links.
lines.crm: CRM: the center of the network. It gets contacts from Cal, Chat and Agents, and its events trigger flows.
lines.cal: Cal: every booking creates or updates the contact in CRM and can trigger a flow.
lines.track: Track: connects to GitHub through a webhook. Agents and Flow open issues.
lines.chat: Chat: saves the conversation on the CRM contact, answers with Docs pages and can hand off to an agent.
lines.docs: Docs: feeds Chat answers and Agents knowledge. Flow creates pages.
lines.flow: Flow: the circle line. Events from every app trigger flows, and flows act on Link, CRM, Track, Chat, Docs, Robots and Agents.
lines.agents: Agents: answers in Chat, creates contacts in CRM, books in Cal, opens issues in Track, reads Docs and runs flows.
lines.robots: Robots: Flow runs robots and the end of every run can trigger a flow.
lines.notes: Notes: runs on its own. It does not connect to other lines yet.
lines.board: Board: runs on its own. It does not connect to other lines yet.

contacts.name: Contacts
contacts.desc: Cal, Chat and Agents create or update the contact in CRM.

crmEvents.name: Events
crmEvents.desc: Contacts, deals and forms trigger flows. A flow creates and updates contacts.

bookings.name: Bookings
bookings.desc: A booking, a reschedule or a cancellation triggers a flow.

messages.name: Messages
messages.desc: A new conversation or message triggers a flow. A flow replies in Chat.

clicks.name: Clicks
clicks.desc: A link created or clicked triggers a flow. A flow creates links.

issues.name: Issues
issues.desc: Issue changes trigger flows. A flow opens issues.

pages.name: Pages
pages.desc: A flow creates pages in Docs.

runs.name: Runs
runs.desc: A flow runs a robot and waits for the result. The end of a run triggers flows.

agentFlows.name: Flows
agentFlows.desc: An agent runs flows, and a flow hands work to an agent.

agentIssues.name: Agent issues
agentIssues.desc: An agent opens issues in Track from a conversation.

knowledge.name: Knowledge
knowledge.desc: An agent answers with the Docs pages you pick.

answers.name: Answers
answers.desc: The Chat bot answers with published Docs pages.

github.name: GitHub
github.desc: PRs and commits that name an issue link it and move its status.

name.title: The name
name.lead: zerosoft is written in lowercase and as one word, also at the start of a sentence. The domain, zerosoft.ai, only goes where an address is needed.
name.productsBody: Each app has a one-word name with an initial capital. Inside the site and the app it stands alone. Outside, the first time, the brand goes first.

logo.title: The logo
logo.lead: The wordmark is zerosoft in narrow, heavy Archivo, with the o of zero turned into a station. The symbol is that station on its own.
logo.clearBody: One station of air on every side: the diameter of the o in zero. Nothing enters that margin.
logo.minBody: The station is never smaller than 15 px, which puts the wordmark at 80 px wide. The symbol, at 16 px.

misuse.stretch: Do not stretch or squeeze it.
misuse.color: Do not paint the station with a line color: the logo is ink or white.
misuse.caps: Do not capitalize it or rebuild it in another typeface.
misuse.effects: Do not add shadows, outlines or gradients.
misuse.contrast: Do not place it on a color that keeps it from reading.
misuse.glyph: Do not replace the station with a typed zero.

stations.title: The stations
stations.lead: The zero in zerosoft is a station: a white circle with a thick black ring, 0.44 of the radius. It shows up in the logo, the map, lists and images.
stations.singleBody: A stop on one line, or an item in a list.
stations.interchangeBody: Two linked rings: two apps meet there.
stations.productBody: The station with its ring in the color of its line.
stations.corners: Everything else has square corners, 0 or 2 px. The circle is kept for stations.

lines.title: The eleven lines
lines.lead: Each app has its line color and keeps it everywhere: color tells you where you are. The line color goes on strokes, stations and fills. Text uses the ink version, which passes AA on white.

type.title: Type
type.lead: One family for everything, Archivo, with its width axis. Narrow and heavy for signage and headings, normal width for reading and using the app. JetBrains Mono only for data.
type.uiSample: Every booking creates the contact in CRM and stays in its history.
type.license: Both are open source, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. They also come in the kit.

voice.title: Voice
voice.lead: Dry and concrete. Name the thing, show the number and cut the rest.

r1.title: Name the thing
r1.body: Say what happens and where, with the name of the app.
r1.yes: A booking in Cal creates the contact in CRM.
r1.no: Supercharge your workflows with smart integrations.

r2.title: Say what it does
r2.body: Describe the product by what it does, without setting it against something else.
r2.yes: Track sorts issues and links them to your GitHub PRs.
r2.no: It's not a task manager, it's your new operating system.

r3.title: Period or colon
r3.body: The em dash is not used. End the sentence or open with a colon.
r3.yes: Flow connects everything: every event can trigger a flow.
r3.no: Flow connects everything — every event triggers a flow.

r4.title: One idea per sentence
r4.body: No “no this, no that” triads. One sentence with a fact is worth more.
r4.yes: The price is cost times 3, and we show both numbers.
r4.no: No limits. No fine print. No surprises.

r5.title: What does not exist is not announced
r5.body: Anything not in production yet says “Coming soon” or does not appear.
r5.yes: Board does not connect to other apps yet.
r5.no: Board integrates with your whole stack.

network.title: The network
network.lead: Every interchange station is an integration that is in the code today. Notes and Board still run on their own.

press.title: Press
press.body: For stories, interviews or material that is not in the kit, write to us.
